plotTitle: Murder at the Drowning Lass: Echoes of Blood and Shadow
mainObjective: Unravel the conspiracy behind a grisly tavern murder and the theft of a legendary treasure map, outwit the Red Maw gang and their rivals, and prevent the awakening of supernatural forces whose influence threatens to plunge the region into chaos.

plotPoints.title: Shadows Beneath the Hearth
plotPoints.description: The party arrives in Brindlehearth Village (BV001) during the bustling Morning Market, where tension hangs thick: a beloved baker has vanished, and rumors swirl of strange lights near the old well. Constable Farrel Dun recruits the party to investigate. Early leads point to the Drowning Lass tavern and suggest the missing baker might be connected to a wider conspiracy. The investigation here sets the party’s reputation in town and uncovers their first hints of trouble brewing beneath the surface.
plotPoints.plotImpact: The party's investigation determines their standing with villagers and uncovers the first hints of an organized conspiracy.

sideQuests.title: Bread and Whispers
sideQuests.description: Help Old Ellyn, the folklore spinner, calm the frightened townsfolk by gathering charms and protective herbs from the market, winning trust and stories in return.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Improved reputation gives the party leverage in social encounters and may reveal additional rumors.

sideQuests.title: Well of Secrets
sideQuests.description: Investigate the old well for signs of the missing baker, possibly uncovering a hidden passage or odd residue suggesting something was dragged below.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Unlocks a shortcut for later exploration and provides an early clue about the underground activity.

plotPoints.title: The Drowning Lass Unveiled
plotPoints.description: The party’s investigation leads to The Drowning Lass tavern (BV001), where a grisly murder has occurred. Inside, they uncover signs of a struggle and evidence of a secret society operating beneath the town's surface. Suspicious regulars and a cryptic ledger hint at connections between the missing townsfolk, the murder, and the infamous Red Maw gang. The clues begin to tie the events in Brindlehearth to a wider criminal plot.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Reveals the link between the disappearances, the tavern, and the Red Maw, setting the stage for confrontation.

sideQuests.title: A Nervous Ear
sideQuests.description: Win the confidence of Gritch the One-Eared, a nervous patron who witnessed something vital, by protecting him from intimidation and coaxing out his secrets.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Gritch provides a clue to a hidden entrance and implicates a local conspirator.

sideQuests.title: Ledger of Shadows
sideQuests.description: Decipher the cryptic ledger found in the tavern's back room to trace payments and coded communications with the Red Maw.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Unlocks additional suspects and pinpoints the next location to investigate.

plotPoints.title: Into the Vale's Underbelly
plotPoints.description: Following clues from the tavern, the party uncovers a hidden tunnel beneath Brindlehearth Village (BV001), leading toward the edge of the Widdershins Moors (WM001). In these shadowy passages, they contend with traps, enforcers, and strange magical wards. Evidence mounts of a plan to abduct key townsfolk for a mysterious ritual, and the party learns of a stolen treasure map—rumored to be the Red Maw’s true prize.
plotPoints.plotImpact: The party discovers the full extent of the Red Maw's plot, setting up a race against time to prevent a ritual sacrifice.

sideQuests.title: Lost in the Tunnels
sideQuests.description: Rescue a frightened child who wandered into the tunnels chasing a lost pet, avoiding traps and gaining a grateful family’s support.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Provides an ally in the form of the child’s family and knowledge of secret exits.

sideQuests.title: Warded Woes
sideQuests.description: Disarm or subvert a series of magical traps left by the Red Maw’s mage, gaining access to a hidden stash of supplies or information.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Unlocks magical resources for the final confrontation or reveals the ritual’s timing.

plotPoints.title: The Ritual at Hearth's Edge
plotPoints.description: On the outskirts of Brindlehearth at a ruined chapel (BV001), the Red Maw prepares to enact a ritual at dawn, using townsfolk as sacrifices to find or unlock the treasure map’s secrets. The party must disrupt the ceremony, confront the Red Maw lieutenant, and decide whether to pursue the gang further or explore the ritual’s supernatural consequences. Their actions here determine the fate of Brindlehearth and who escapes with the map.
plotPoints.plotImpact: The party's actions here resolve the main arc in Brindlehearth and shape the future of the Vale.

sideQuests.title: The Folklore Spinner’s Boon
sideQuests.description: Call upon Old Ellyn’s knowledge of old rites to counter the ritual's magic, if the party won her trust earlier.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Makes disrupting the ritual easier or less dangerous.

sideQuests.title: Captured Comrades
sideQuests.description: Free captured villagers during the chaos, facing difficult choices between saving innocents or chasing down the Red Maw’s leader.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Each choice affects who survives and the party’s reputation in the Vale.

plotPoints.title: Blood Trails to the Red Maw Wilds
plotPoints.description: With leads from the disrupted ritual and possibly a fragment of the treasure map, the party is commissioned by a desperate trader whose caravans have been vanishing near the Red Maw Wilds (RME001). The stolen goods may be linked to the map’s true value. Investigating this lawless wilderness, the party tracks the Red Maw’s movements, learning that the gang’s power is threatened by internal strife and a rival cult.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Entry into the Red Maw Wilds, establishing the stakes and introducing the area’s dangers. Success or failure here affects available allies and knowledge.

sideQuests.title: Hunter or Hunted
sideQuests.description: The party stumbles upon a wounded predator caught in a cruel trap. Freeing it may earn a wild ally or provoke a territorial beast.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Animal ally might aid party later or become a hostile encounter.

sideQuests.title: Campfire Whispers
sideQuests.description: Scattered camps of rival scavengers and outcasts offer information for the right price—or might ambush the party.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Gaining information here can grant shortcuts or warnings for later plot points.

plotPoints.title: The Shattered Pact
plotPoints.description: In the Red Maw Wilds (RME001), the party discovers a fragile truce between rival warbands has collapsed after the theft of a legendary totem—said to be tied to the same ancient magic as the treasure map. Each faction blames the other, and outsiders are viewed with suspicion. Navigating this powder keg, the party learns the map’s legend is no mere rumor: it may lead to a power that could sway the Wilds, or unleash something far worse.
plotPoints.plotImpact: The party’s alliances and approach to the fractured warbands determine the opposition and possible support in the coming climax.

sideQuests.title: Totem of the Crimson Fang
sideQuests.description: A cunning warband leader offers information or safe passage in exchange for retrieving a stolen totem from a treacherous ravine haunted by bloodthirsty fey.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Returning the totem can secure a powerful, if unpredictable, ally.

sideQuests.title: Echoes in the Stones
sideQuests.description: Rumors speak of a hidden shrine among the jagged outcrops. Exploring it may reveal ancestral secrets—or awaken violent guardians.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Discovering the shrine can provide magical boons or critical lore about the Wilds.

plotPoints.title: The Ravager’s Gambit
plotPoints.description: Evidence reveals that neither warband is responsible for the recent violence; instead, a cult devoted to an ancient, blood-hungry spirit has orchestrated the chaos, hoping to claim the treasure map and totem for a catastrophic summoning. Their lair, hidden beneath the wilds’ deepest thicket, pulses with malevolent energy. The party must infiltrate the cult, disrupt their ritual, and prevent the spirit’s awakening—racing against any Red Maw survivors who might seize the map for themselves.
plotPoints.plotImpact: The party’s handling of the cult and the spirit’s fate determines the final shape of power in the Wilds.

sideQuests.title: Masks of the Wilds
sideQuests.description: To infiltrate the cult undetected, the party must obtain ritual masks from a paranoid recluse who knows their secrets.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Obtaining the masks greatly improves infiltration success and opens non-combat options during the cult encounter.

plotPoints.title: Red Maw’s Reckoning
plotPoints.description: Within the cult’s blood-soaked chamber (RME001), the party faces a climactic confrontation with the cult leader and the partially-summoned spirit. The battle’s outcome—and the party’s choices—will reshape the fate of the Wilds and determine if the Red Maw gang is ended or simply scattered, and whether the treasure map is lost, found, or imbued with new power.
plotPoints.plotImpact: The party’s decisions determine whether the Wilds descend into further bloodshed, find an uneasy peace, or fall under the sway of an ancient, monstrous power.

sideQuests.title: Scars and Spoils
sideQuests.description: Following the battle, wounded warband survivors offer knowledge, rare weapons, or hidden caches in exchange for aid or a share of the spoils.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Securing these bargains can yield rewards, future plot hooks, or lingering rivalries.

plotPoints.title: Blood Oaths Beneath Canvas
plotPoints.description: With the Red Maw gang’s power broken and the map’s secrets partially unveiled, the party traces the last leads to the Barrowmire Settlements (THB001), where a murderer is rumored to be hiding among the outlaws. The settlements are beset by restless dead, and the party must navigate a fearful, insular community to uncover the murderer and learn how the map’s legend is bound to ancient barrows beneath the mists.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Introduces the supernatural threat of the restless dead and connects the murder investigation to the region’s deeper mysteries.

sideQuests.title: Lost in the Mist
sideQuests.description: A child has vanished after following a ghostlight into the old burial mounds. Searching for the child might provide clues to the escalating hauntings.
sideQuests.plotImpact: May yield a spectral token linked to the main threat and earn the villagers’ trust.

sideQuests.title: Secrets Beneath the Tavern
sideQuests.description: Strange noises and cold drafts emanate from beneath the Drowned Lantern tavern. Investigating may reveal hidden catacombs or a spirit anchor.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Provides shortcuts or secret knowledge for future plot points.

plotPoints.title: Echoes of the Barrowmire
plotPoints.description: Exploring the ancient barrows at the settlement’s edge (THB001), the party uncovers arcane sigils and evidence that someone—possibly the murderer they seek—has been tampering with the graves. The supernatural events are confirmed to be connected to a deliberate act, and clues reveal the treasure map’s origin may lie in the oldest barrow, bound by a forgotten curse.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Confirms the supernatural events are connected to a deliberate act and raises the stakes.

sideQuests.title: The Mournful Piper
sideQuests.description: A ghostly figure plays mournful tunes at dusk. Learning the Piper’s story may grant insight into the settlement’s history—or provide a powerful spirit ally.
sideQuests.plotImpact: The Piper’s favor could grant advantages during spirit encounters.

plotPoints.title: The Living and the Dead
plotPoints.description: The investigation points to a reclusive outsider, Dolwen Marsh, who claims he’s trying to contain a much greater evil beneath the barrows (THB001). As the dead begin to rise in greater numbers, the party must decide whether to help Dolwen, expose him, or find another solution—while learning that the curse protecting the map’s final secret is nearly broken.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Builds to a moral dilemma with lasting effects on both the settlement and its dead; choices set the stage for the climax.

sideQuests.title: A Bargain with the Widow Shade
sideQuests.description: A powerful spirit, the Widow Shade, offers information and protection in exchange for a favor: reuniting her lost locket with her grave.
sideQuests.plotImpact: The Widow’s help can make the final confrontation easier or provide a vital clue.

plotPoints.title: Night of Restless Shadows
plotPoints.description: A powerful force animates the spirits and dead of Barrowmire (THB001), threatening to overrun the living. The party must confront the awakened curse beneath the largest barrow—now revealed to be a ward for the map’s secret. Succeeding here determines whether the map’s true path is revealed, and whether Barrowmire survives.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Resolution shapes the fate of Barrowmire—choices determine whether the settlement survives, falls, or remains forever haunted.

sideQuests.title: The Last Light
sideQuests.description: The town’s spirit ward, a beacon keeping the worst hauntings at bay, is failing. Repairing or defending it during the climax could buy precious time.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Success makes the final encounter less deadly; failure increases the challenge and cost to the townsfolk.

plotPoints.title: Shadows Along the King’s Tread
plotPoints.description: With the map’s final clue in hand, the party follows its path to The King’s Tread (OKR001)—an ancient, haunted road said to lead to the hidden treasure. Travelers have reported disappearances and spectral processions. To reach the treasure, the party must investigate the supernatural and mundane threats along the road, gathering lore and surviving ambushes.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Introduces the supernatural and mundane threats along The King’s Tread, and allows the party to uncover the rumor of a cursed royal procession.

sideQuests.title: The Vanished Caravan
sideQuests.description: Search the overgrown roadside for clues about a missing merchant caravan; find evidence of struggle and strange, spectral footprints.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Revealing the involvement of both wolves and ghostly figures, hinting at connections between the mundane and supernatural hazards.

sideQuests.title: Wolfpack Hunt
sideQuests.description: Track and confront a pack of unnaturally cunning wolves that have been ambushing travelers, possibly led by an intelligent, spectral dire wolf.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Defeating or negotiating with the wolves can reduce future ambushes or gain temporary allies.

plotPoints.title: The Milestone’s Curse
plotPoints.description: Deeper investigation along The King’s Tread (OKR001) reveals ancient milestones inscribed with binding runes, and the party encounters ghostly apparitions of a lost king’s retinue. The path to the map’s treasure and the next supernatural threat is blocked by a curse that must be understood—and possibly lifted—before the party can continue.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Provides key lore about the ancient curse and the royal tragedy that binds the souls to the road.

sideQuests.title: Echoes of the Past
sideQuests.description: Help a lingering ghostly squire recall his unfinished duty, piecing together pages from a scattered royal decree.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Completing the squire’s request earns the party a clue to breaking the curse or a protective charm.

sideQuests.title: Highwayman’s Parley
sideQuests.description: Negotiate with—or defeat—a gang of highwaymen who have begun to worship the restless spirits, believing them omens of fortune.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Parleying may reveal a hidden shortcut to the royal tomb or information about the curse’s catalyst.

plotPoints.title: Procession of the Forgotten King
plotPoints.description: The party uncovers the site of a ruined royal camp deep in the mist-shrouded King’s Tread (OKR001), where the cursed procession replays its last moments each night. They must intervene within the spectral re-enactment, confronting the ghostly king and his loyal retainers. Choices made here determine whether the curse is ended, and whether the final path to the treasure is revealed.
plotPoints.plotImpact: The party’s actions can end the curse or doom the ghosts to continue haunting The King’s Tread—and may draw the attention of other supernatural forces.

sideQuests.title: The Royal Wolf
sideQuests.description: A spectral dire wolf, the former king’s hound, guards the camp. Appeasing, befriending, or banishing it can sway the king’s spirit in the final confrontation.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Winning the wolf’s loyalty can aid in the spectral battle or grant safe passage after the climax.

plotPoints.title: The King’s Tread Restored
plotPoints.description: After the curse is resolved, the mists lift from The King’s Tread (OKR001), allowing the party to continue their search for the treasure’s true resting place—rumored to be connected to the depths of the Stoneheart Chasmlands (SR001). Unresolved consequences—such as surviving highwaymen, freed spirits, or unleashed magical energies—set hooks for what lies below.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Wraps up the main arc; the party’s choices affect the fate of The King’s Tread, its people, and the lingering spirits.

sideQuests.title: Return of the Lost
sideQuests.description: Help families reunite with those saved or recovered from the Tread, or escort new travelers safely through the restored road.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Builds goodwill among locals, earns rewards, and seeds future quests.

sideQuests.title: Secrets in the Stone
sideQuests.description: Hidden beneath one of the ancient milestones is a sealed royal artifact, now accessible. Deciding what to do with it could invite further intrigue.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Recovering the artifact leads to future political or magical complications.

plotPoints.title: Descent into the Stoneheart Chasmlands
plotPoints.description: The party follows the treasure map’s clues to the Stoneheart Chasmlands (SR001), a dungeon of jagged cliffs, shadowy gorges, and ancient tunnels. Here, they seek the Heartshard Geode—an artifact said to be the key to the map’s power. The journey below is fraught with hazards both natural and supernatural, and the party must contend with rival treasure-seekers drawn by rumors of the map’s awakening magic.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Establishes the location's dangers and the artifact's lure, setting up both the main quest and the ongoing threat of collapse.

sideQuests.title: The Lost Surveyors
sideQuests.description: Rescue or recover evidence of a missing surveyor team lost in the chasmlands. Their notes may reveal secret tunnels or traps.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Provides additional knowledge (safe routes, hazards, or bypasses) that can help in later exploration.

sideQuests.title: Predator in the Shadows
sideQuests.description: A territorial chasm-stalker has been hunting in the upper tunnels. Locating and confronting it can prevent future ambushes.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Felling the beast can win the trust of a hidden outcast (NPC) deeper within.

plotPoints.title: Echoes of the Deep
plotPoints.description: Within the labyrinthine stone corridors of the Chasmlands (SR001), the party encounters evidence of ancient burials and strange metallic veins pulsing with magical energy—the same type found in the treasure map’s ink. The deeper they go, the more they are harried by spectral guardians and illusions. They must decipher ancient inscriptions to find the artifact’s true resting place.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Reveals that the artifact is protected by more than just natural hazards; social and investigative skills become crucial.

sideQuests.title: The Echoing Pact
sideQuests.description: An ancient ghost, Melaun the Bound, offers aid if the party can resolve his unfinished business—reuniting two halves of a broken amulet.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Completing this quest pacifies some spectral threats and grants magical aid.

plotPoints.title: The Broken Brotherhood
plotPoints.description: In a massive subterranean gallery (SR001), the party discovers the outlawed remnant of the Stone Brotherhood—a secretive order that once guarded the chasmlands and now seeks to claim the Heartshard Geode for themselves. The Brotherhood’s interest in the map’s magic collides with the party’s goals. Negotiation, infiltration, or confrontation will shape the final battle for the artifact.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Introduces a key faction with competing goals. Player choices here shape the final confrontation and potential alliances.

sideQuests.title: Double-Edged Offer
sideQuests.description: Brotherhood lieutenant Varek will betray his leader for a share of the prize. Will the party trust him?
sideQuests.plotImpact: Allying with Varek bypasses some traps, but risks a double-cross later.

sideQuests.title: Collapse Alarm
sideQuests.description: Sabotaged supports threaten a catastrophic cave-in. Preventing disaster could save innocents or trap rivals—but at what risk?
sideQuests.plotImpact: Saving the gallery from collapse may cost precious time, but preserves key routes and resources.

plotPoints.title: Heart of the Chasm
plotPoints.description: At the deepest vault (SR001), the party faces a climactic confrontation for control of the Heartshard Geode—now revealed to be the map’s ultimate secret. Rivals, spectral guardians, and desperate factions converge as the artifact’s power warps reality. The party must choose: seize the geode, destroy it, or use its power to bargain with desperate factions, including the Red Maw’s remnants. Their decisions here reshape the fate of the Chasmlands and the region.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Climactic showdown with high stakes and multiple possible endings based on the party's alliances, actions, and moral choices.

sideQuests.title: The Shard's Will
sideQuests.description: The Heartshard Geode’s lingering consciousness offers a bargain—safeguard its legacy, and it will grant boons or visions.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Choosing to heed or reject the geode’s offer shapes the dungeon’s future and possible epilogue boons or curses.

plotPoints.title: Whispers from the Resonant Abyss
plotPoints.description: Having uncovered the map’s true power, the party is summoned to Deepharrow, a mining outpost above the Resonant Abyss (EDC001), where miners have vanished and unnatural echoes lure the unwary. Locals believe the disturbances are linked to the same magic that awakened in the Chasmlands. The party must investigate the outpost and prepare for a descent into the Abyss.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Sets up the Abyss as the next threat and provides hooks and knowledge crucial for survival below.

sideQuests.title: Echoes in the Walls
sideQuests.description: Some outpost workers are in catatonic states, unable to speak except by humming strange melodies. If the party can calm or heal one, they may learn key details about hazards or secret passages within the Abyss.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Reveals a hidden route in the Abyss, bypassing a deadly trap.

sideQuests.title: The Lost Satchel
sideQuests.description: A miner’s satchel containing a journal and a unique tuning fork is missing. Recovering it from a collapsed tunnel helps prepare the party for challenges below.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Provides a tool that aids in controlling the Abyss' reverberating hazards.

plotPoints.title: Descent into the Endless Echoes
plotPoints.description: The party enters the Resonant Abyss (EDC001), a labyrinth of stone corridors and vast chasms where every sound is amplified and distorted. They must brave deadly hazards, echo-sensitive traps, and abyssal horrors as they learn the ancient chasm has been awakened by recent events—possibly tied to the party’s own actions with the Heartshard Geode.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Draws the party deeper, escalating danger and introducing the Abyss' unique threats—dissonant creatures and shifting, living stone.

sideQuests.title: Silent Steps
sideQuests.description: A narrow side passage offers a shortcut, but it’s filled with sound-sensitive fungus. Crossing without triggering a spore burst requires clever stealth or magic.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Allows the party to avoid a dangerous monster, though the fungus may have useful alchemical properties.

sideQuests.title: The Broken Bell
sideQuests.description: A hidden alcove contains a broken resonance bell. Repairing it or deciphering its runes provides insight into the nature of the Abyss and may ward off certain horrors.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Unlocks a one-time protective ward against echo-horrors.

plotPoints.title: The Echoing Throne
plotPoints.description: At the heart of the Abyss (EDC001), the party finds the source of the disturbances: the Resonant Sovereign, an ancient entity partially awakened by the miners’ intrusion and the magical upheaval above. The Sovereign can communicate, offering cryptic bargains or threats. The party must choose between combat, negotiation, or attempting to reseal the entity—each path with its own peril and consequence for the region.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Climactic confrontation; the party's choices determine the fate of the Abyss and the outpost above.

sideQuests.title: Voices of the Past
sideQuests.description: Ghostly echoes of previous explorers linger. If the party can appease these spirits or learn from their fate, they may gain leverage in negotiations or discover a ritual to help subdue the Resonant Sovereign.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Provides vital lore and possibly an advantage during the confrontation.

plotPoints.title: Resonance Unbound—or Silenced
plotPoints.description: With the Sovereign defeated, bargained with, or resealed (EDC001), the party must escape as the Abyss destabilizes. Their actions decide whether the Abyss becomes a continuing threat, a dormant power, or a source of knowledge and opportunity for the surface world. Surviving miners and townsfolk will remember the party’s choices.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Resolution of the adventure, with multiple possible outcomes and the party's reputation or future quests shaped by their choices.

sideQuests.title: The Last Echo
sideQuests.description: A lone survivor is trapped in a collapsing tunnel. Rescuing them requires speed and ingenuity, but they may possess vital information or rewards.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Provides a reward and potentially an influential ally in Deepharrow.

sideQuests.title: Echoes for Sale
sideQuests.description: Strange crystals harvested from the Abyss retain lingering echoes. The party can attempt to retrieve these dangerous artifacts on their way out, but doing so risks additional hazards.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Crystals can be sold or studied, granting wealth or magical research opportunities.

plotPoints.title: Arrival in the Hearthwood Vale
plotPoints.description: As the party rests, rumors reach them that the Hearthwood Vale (HG001)—once a peaceful town—now suffers from mysterious disappearances and haunting music. The mayor asks for help, believing the disturbances are linked to the magical upheavals caused by the party’s earlier actions. The party’s reputation precedes them, and their choices across the module begin to echo in the Vale’s fate.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Introduces the core mystery and themes of community, trust, and hidden threats.

sideQuests.title: The Baker's Worry
sideQuests.description: Jarmel the baker is distraught over his missing apprentice. Investigating his shop could turn up clues or a hidden message.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Provides the party with a clue about the apprentice’s last known contact and hints at a secret meeting spot in the woods.

sideQuests.title: Lantern Light Watch
sideQuests.description: The town watch invites the party to join a night patrol for strange activity. They may spot a suspicious cloaked figure or uncover evidence of something unnatural disturbing the vale’s peace.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Reveals either a physical clue or an early encounter with a minor shadowy creature.

plotPoints.title: The Hidden Heart of the Vale
plotPoints.description: As the party gathers clues (HG001), they discover the missing townsfolk are being lured by haunting music and dreams to the ancient woods. Investigation leads to a concealed glen where a fey-blooded minstrel, Silwen, seeks to awaken an ancient spirit—her magic heightened by the map’s recent disturbances. The final secret of the treasure map is revealed: it was a seal, not a guide, and now the party must decide if the spirit should be awakened, bargained with, or resealed.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Shifts the mystery from mundane to magical, introducing the antagonist and connecting disappearances to the supernatural.

sideQuests.title: The Old Bell-Tower
sideQuests.description: An eccentric local claims the abandoned bell-tower overlooks the glen and holds a secret about the spirit beneath the vale.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Provides magical or physical resources that will help in the coming confrontation with Silwen.

plotPoints.title: Confrontation Beneath the Lantern Boughs
plotPoints.description: The party faces Silwen and her enchanted thralls (HG001) as she attempts the ritual. The fate of the Vale hangs in the balance—player choices here are shaped by all they have learned about folklore, sacrifice, and the dangers of awakening powers best left sleeping. The enchanted townsfolk complicate matters, forcing players to balance aggression with care.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Leads to the climax; player choices determine the fate of the townsfolk and the spirit.

sideQuests.title: The Minstrel’s Lament
sideQuests.description: If players seek to talk or learn more, they may discover Silwen’s true motivation: she is tormented by a bargain struck long ago. Finding her binding contract could allow a peaceful resolution.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Unlocks a peaceful or redemptive ending if pursued, sparing the townsfolk and the fey.

sideQuests.title: Free the Enchanted
sideQuests.description: Players can attempt to break the magical hold on the townsfolk mid-confrontation. This risks splitting their efforts but may win them grateful allies—or endanger the innocent.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Successfully freeing the townsfolk alters the balance of the encounter and the aftermath in the town.

plotPoints.title: Restoration in Hearthwood Vale
plotPoints.description: With the ritual thwarted (or resolved), the party helps the townsfolk recover (HG001). The Vale celebrates with a festival of lanterns, but the party must decide how to deal with Silwen and the slumbering spirit—seal it away, bargain with it, or learn from its wisdom. The outcome offers lasting consequences for the region and potential hooks for future adventures.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Concludes the adventure, offers lasting consequences for the town and potential future hooks.

sideQuests.title: Lantern Festival of Thanks
sideQuests.description: The townsfolk invite the party to be honored guests at the festival. They may discover lingering magical effects, gain unique allies, or hear rumors of disturbances elsewhere.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Grants the party favors, new contacts, and potential hooks for future adventures.
